channel.title: Said & Checked: Trade and Tariffs — AskAmerica
channel.description: What officeholders said each day about Trade and Tariffs, and which statements government data supports, contradicts or rules out.

item.title: Said & Checked, Trade and Tariffs, 2026-11-18: none false or contradicted, 1 unsettled (Donald Trump)
item.description:
No statement was found false or contradicted.

Unsettled

  • Donald Trump, President of the United States: “Reported as: He said after their meeting that the two nations had reached a trade deal on Wednesday, though he had also said last year that an agreement had been reached.” Unsettled. No official document from either government announcing a U.S.-Philippines trade agreement on Nov. 18 was found; the White House said only that it involves Manila buying more energy and farm products. A news report says Marcos's office described an 'understanding on areas of economic cooperation' and the Philippine ambassador said nothing was signed.

6 statements by 3 officeholders. 3 checked: 2 supported, 1 unsettled · 2 not yet checked · 1 not checkable.

item.title: Said & Checked, Trade and Tariffs, 2026-11-15: none false or contradicted, 1 unsettled (Mike Pence)
item.description:
No statement was found false or contradicted.

Unsettled

  • Mike Pence, Former Vice President of the United States: “not only broad-based tariffs on friend and foe alike, but nationalizing 41 American businesses, in part, price controls on pharmaceuticals and credit cards.” Unsettled. No agency publishes a list of federal ownership stakes in companies. A 24/7 Wall St. article says private tallies run from 30 to 43, so 41 is within their range but is not an official figure, and the stakes are minority holdings. No primary document on price controls for pharmaceuticals or credit cards was read.
